description: This file defines the Swift source code for the WebChatUI component of an application, including UI layout configurations, a transport layer for chat interactions with external services, and a window controller class for managing chat window presentation and behavior in a macOS environment.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUIWindowController
classes.description: A class managing the creation, display, and dismissal of the chat UI window/panel in a macOS app, handling positioning, appearance, and user interaction.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the chat window or panel and brings it to the front.

methods.name: presentAnchored
methods.description: Displays the chat UI anchored near a provided anchor point, with animation if needed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the chat window or panel and triggers dismissal callbacks.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Calculates and sets the position of the window relative to an anchor point or defaults.
